records.name: identifier
records.definition: Stable machine-readable identity for one registry object or instance.
inputs: namespace plus local name or generated UUID
validation: unique within declared namespace; immutable after publication
constraints: unique within declared namespace; immutable after publication

records.name: namespace
records.definition: Scope that prevents otherwise identical names from colliding.
validation: resolvable or locally documented; no ambiguous aliases
constraints: resolvable or locally documented; no ambiguous aliases

records.name: type tag
records.definition: Declared semantic class of a value or object.
validation: must resolve to a registered type
constraints: must resolve to a registered type

records.name: version
records.definition: Ordered identity for a released state of an item or schema.
validation: matches policy and does not silently overwrite prior meaning
constraints: matches policy and does not silently overwrite prior meaning

records.name: status
records.definition: Lifecycle state such as proposed, implemented, test-passed, usage-backed, repeated, portable, deprecated or failed.
validation: transition allowed by lifecycle state machine
constraints: transition allowed by lifecycle state machine

records.name: boolean
records.definition: Two-state truth value used only where a binary distinction is honest.
validation: no hidden third state; use unknown/null when evidence is absent
constraints: no hidden third state; use unknown/null when evidence is absent

records.name: integer
records.definition: Whole-number quantity with declared range and unit when applicable.
validation: within declared minimum and maximum
constraints: within declared minimum and maximum

records.name: floating-point number
records.definition: Approximate real-number value with explicit precision expectations.
validation: finite unless non-finite values are explicitly allowed
constraints: finite unless non-finite values are explicitly allowed

records.name: string
records.definition: Ordered text value with declared encoding, language or pattern when needed.
validation: encoding valid; pattern and length constraints pass
constraints: encoding valid; pattern and length constraints pass

records.name: byte sequence
records.definition: Ordered raw bytes for binary payloads or exact-byte evidence.
validation: declared length and digest match
constraints: declared length and digest match

records.name: unit
records.definition: Named measurement unit attached to a numeric quantity.
validation: dimensionally compatible with the quantity
constraints: dimensionally compatible with the quantity

records.name: timestamp
records.definition: Point on a declared time scale.
validation: timezone and precision are explicit
constraints: timezone and precision are explicit

records.name: duration
records.definition: Measured or planned interval of time.
validation: non-negative unless signed intervals are explicitly supported
constraints: non-negative unless signed intervals are explicitly supported

records.name: URI
records.definition: Portable reference to a resource, concept or local address.
validation: syntactically valid and scheme policy allowed
constraints: syntactically valid and scheme policy allowed

records.name: hash digest
records.definition: Content-derived fingerprint used to detect changes when the reference digest and verification path are protected.
validation: algorithm declared and recomputation matches
constraints: algorithm declared and recomputation matches

records.name: deterministic seed
records.definition: Recorded value that initializes a reproducible pseudo-random or procedural route.
validation: same implementation and version replay to the same trace
constraints: same implementation and version replay to the same trace

records.name: parameter
records.definition: Named controllable input that changes a component or organ without changing its identity.
validation: type and constraints pass
constraints: type and constraints pass

records.name: constraint
records.definition: Machine-testable limit on values, relationships, order or allowed behavior.
validation: deterministic pass fail or explicit unknown
constraints: deterministic pass fail or explicit unknown

records.name: input port
records.definition: Typed entry point through which a component or organ accepts data or capability.
validation: incoming value type and cardinality match
constraints: incoming value type and cardinality match

records.name: output port
records.definition: Typed exit point through which a component or organ emits a result or evidence.
validation: emitted value conforms to contract
constraints: emitted value conforms to contract

records.name: reference
records.definition: Link to another registered object without copying or silently changing it.
validation: target exists or is explicitly external/unresolved
constraints: target exists or is explicitly external/unresolved

records.name: relation predicate
records.definition: Typed meaning attached to an edge between registry objects.
validation: domain and range rules pass
constraints: domain and range rules pass

records.name: event
records.definition: Recorded occurrence with type, time, source and payload.
validation: required identity time and source fields exist
constraints: required identity time and source fields exist

records.name: state
records.definition: Named condition of a component, organ, workflow or capability at one point in time.
validation: state belongs to declared machine
constraints: state belongs to declared machine

records.name: condition
records.definition: Predicate evaluated before a transition, rule or route may proceed.
validation: evaluation is side-effect free unless declared otherwise
constraints: evaluation is side-effect free unless declared otherwise

records.name: action
records.definition: Declared operation invoked by a rule, workflow or user decision.
validation: authority and preconditions pass
constraints: authority and preconditions pass

records.name: token
records.definition: Small typed symbol produced by lexical or domain segmentation.
validation: source offsets and token type are valid
constraints: source offsets and token type are valid

records.name: node reference
records.definition: Identity of a node inside a graph, tree, scene or workflow.
inputs: graph identity plus local node identity
validation: node exists in the addressed structure
constraints: node exists in the addressed structure

records.name: edge
records.definition: Connection between two node references with direction and optional predicate.
validation: endpoints and relationship rules pass
constraints: endpoints and relationship rules pass

records.name: coordinate
records.definition: Position value in a declared coordinate system and dimensionality.
inputs: ordered numeric values plus coordinate-system reference
validation: dimension count and units match the system
constraints: dimension count and units match the system

records.name: vector
records.definition: Ordered numeric tuple representing direction, displacement or multi-dimensional value.
validation: declared dimension and units pass
constraints: declared dimension and units pass

records.name: matrix
records.definition: Rectangular numeric array used for transforms, linear maps or structured data.
validation: shape and numeric constraints pass
constraints: shape and numeric constraints pass

records.name: color value
records.definition: Color sample expressed in an explicit color space with optional alpha.
validation: channel count and range match color space
constraints: channel count and range match color space

records.name: sample
records.definition: One measured, generated or selected observation from a signal, field or dataset.
inputs: value coordinate or time plus provenance
validation: sampling domain and units are declared
constraints: sampling domain and units are declared

records.name: frame
records.definition: One time-indexed image, pose, audio block or state snapshot.
validation: timebase and payload type are declared
constraints: timebase and payload type are declared

records.name: keyframe
records.definition: Authored or generated value fixed at a particular time for interpolation.
validation: target exists and time lies on timeline
constraints: target exists and time lies on timeline

records.name: instruction
records.definition: Atomic executable operation in a declared language or intermediate representation.
validation: opcode and operand types are valid
constraints: opcode and operand types are valid

records.name: source span
records.definition: Exact start and end location in source text or binary from which an item was derived.
validation: range falls inside immutable source version
constraints: range falls inside immutable source version

records.name: license expression
records.definition: Machine-readable statement of applicable license terms.
validation: syntax valid and referenced licenses known
constraints: syntax valid and referenced licenses known

records.name: generation assertion
records.definition: Provenance statement that an activity produced an entity.
validation: referenced entities and activity exist
constraints: referenced entities and activity exist

records.name: evidence item
records.definition: Addressable observation, test result, source or receipt supporting or challenging a claim.
validation: source and integrity information are present
constraints: source and integrity information are present

records.name: usage event reference
records.definition: Reference to a real use of a capability, including context and outcome.
validation: event exists and result state is explicit
constraints: event exists and result state is explicit

records.name: assertion
records.definition: Machine-checkable expected relationship between actual and expected values.
validation: comparison semantics and tolerance are declared
constraints: comparison semantics and tolerance are declared

records.name: confidence value
records.definition: Bounded estimate of evidence strength, never a replacement for evidence itself.
validation: method, range and basis are declared
constraints: method, range and basis are declared

records.name: failure signature
records.definition: Stable description or digest of a reproducible failure pattern.
validation: reproduction evidence or explicit single-observation status
constraints: reproduction evidence or explicit single-observation status

records.name: capability tag
records.definition: Controlled label describing what an item can do rather than what it is called.
validation: resolves to capability registry
constraints: resolves to capability registry

records.name: target-format tag
records.definition: Identifier for a representation or format an item can emit or consume.
validation: format profile exists
constraints: format profile exists

records.name: typed record
records.definition: Named collection of fields governed by a schema.
validation: all required fields and constraints pass
constraints: all required fields and constraints pass

records.name: schema
records.definition: Machine-readable declaration of allowed structure types constraints and references.
validation: schema self-validates and has a versioned identifier
constraints: schema self-validates and has a versioned identifier

records.name: manifest
records.definition: Inventory and identity record for the files components dependencies and metadata in one package.
validation: listed contents and digests match reality
constraints: listed contents and digests match reality

records.name: dependency record
records.definition: Typed requirement from one item to another with version capability and optionality rules.
validation: target resolves or gap is explicit
constraints: target resolves or gap is explicit

records.name: property set
records.definition: Reusable named group of typed properties applied to an object.
validation: all values conform to definitions
constraints: all values conform to definitions

records.name: graph
records.definition: Nodes and typed edges representing relationships and dependency routes.
validation: identifiers unique and edge constraints pass
constraints: identifiers unique and edge constraints pass

records.name: tree
records.definition: Hierarchical graph in which each child has one declared parent within the tree.
validation: no cycles and parent rules pass
constraints: no cycles and parent rules pass

records.name: timeline
records.definition: Ordered temporal container for tracks events clips markers and synchronization.
validation: timebase valid and placement constraints pass
constraints: timebase valid and placement constraints pass

records.name: state machine
records.definition: Finite or hierarchical states with transitions guards events and actions.
validation: initial state exists and transitions resolve
constraints: initial state exists and transitions resolve

records.name: grammar definition
records.definition: Formal rules describing valid tokens structures and combinations in a language or creation vocabulary.
validation: parser generation or grammar checks complete
constraints: parser generation or grammar checks complete

records.name: abstract syntax tree
records.definition: Semantic tree of parsed structure without irrelevant source formatting.
validation: nodes match grammar and semantic rules
constraints: nodes match grammar and semantic rules

records.name: module
records.definition: Versioned code unit with explicit imports exports and execution boundary.
validation: dependencies resolve and static checks pass
constraints: dependencies resolve and static checks pass

records.name: package manifest
records.definition: Package identity scripts dependencies entrypoints and distribution metadata.
validation: schema passes and referenced files exist
constraints: schema passes and referenced files exist

records.name: service contract
records.definition: Machine-readable description of operations messages schemas security and server bindings.
validation: specification validator passes
constraints: specification validator passes

records.name: table
records.definition: Rows and columns governed by field types keys and constraints.
validation: row constraints and key uniqueness pass
constraints: row constraints and key uniqueness pass

records.name: UI element
records.definition: Accessible interface element with role state properties styling and interaction behavior.
validation: accessibility and interaction contract pass
constraints: accessibility and interaction contract pass

records.name: layout container
records.definition: Component that positions and sizes child elements under explicit layout rules.
validation: no unsatisfied required constraints
constraints: no unsatisfied required constraints

records.name: raster image
records.definition: Two-dimensional grid of pixel samples with dimensions channels color information and metadata.
validation: dimensions channels and encoding are consistent
constraints: dimensions channels and encoding are consistent

records.name: vector shape
records.definition: Resolution-independent 2D geometry built from paths or primitives plus fill and stroke properties.
validation: path commands and paint references are valid
constraints: path commands and paint references are valid

records.name: mesh
records.definition: 3D surface geometry composed of vertices topology attributes and optional material groups.
validation: index bounds topology and required attributes pass
constraints: index bounds topology and required attributes pass

records.name: sparse volume
records.definition: Memory-efficient spatial grid storing values only in active regions.
validation: grid transform and active topology are coherent
constraints: grid transform and active topology are coherent

records.name: material
records.definition: Appearance contract connecting surface or volume properties to a shading model.
validation: all required inputs bind and target renderer supports them
constraints: all required inputs bind and target renderer supports them

records.name: shader graph
records.definition: Directed graph of typed shader nodes and connections that computes appearance or GPU data.
validation: types connect and graph has valid outputs
constraints: types connect and graph has valid outputs

records.name: animation clip
records.definition: Bounded set of animation tracks over a shared time interval.
validation: targets resolve and keyframes are ordered
constraints: targets resolve and keyframes are ordered

records.name: audio buffer
records.definition: Time-ordered sampled audio data with declared rate channels and format.
validation: sample count and channel layout agree
constraints: sample count and channel layout agree

records.name: document section
records.definition: Structured document region containing blocks with semantic role and ordering.
validation: document structure and references pass
constraints: document structure and references pass

records.name: model graph
records.definition: AI model computation graph containing operators tensors attributes inputs and outputs.
validation: operator schemas shapes and graph connectivity pass
constraints: operator schemas shapes and graph connectivity pass

records.name: test case
records.definition: Repeatable setup action and expected outcome for one behavior or property.
validation: result and evidence recorded deterministically where possible
constraints: result and evidence recorded deterministically where possible

records.name: provenance graph
records.definition: Graph linking entities activities agents sources and transformations.
validation: references resolve and mandatory source facts exist
constraints: references resolve and mandatory source facts exist

records.name: evidence packet
records.definition: Portable bundle of claims observations tests usage receipts sources and integrity references.
validation: every claim links to evidence or explicit unknown
constraints: every claim links to evidence or explicit unknown

records.name: generator recipe
records.definition: Versioned declarative route that turns parameters and source primitives into derived outputs.
validation: replay matches declared deterministic envelope
constraints: replay matches declared deterministic envelope

records.name: compatibility profile
records.definition: Declared source and target features mappings losses and fallback rules for interoperability.

constraints: round-trip and loss tests recorded

records.definition: Stores versioned capabilities, interfaces, dependencies, evidence state and lifecycle.
validation: schema, identity and relationship checks pass
constraints: schema, identity and relationship checks pass
